interpretation: Gross/net stresses and bore pressure are nominal section checks, not local contact/eye stresses.
Euler load is an ideal elastic column result. Inelastic behavior, eccentricity, bearing/joint flexibility and imperfections require design checks; it is not an allowable compression rating.
Fatigue, fretting, local bore/ligament stresses, out-of-plane bending, toughness and retention are not closed.
The200kN probe is not a proof-load instruction or an accepted coupling rating.
Basic spherical-plain bearing C/C0 figures are not whole-coupler load ratings.
